cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Your Turn
cards.instruction: Get someone to accept responsibility for a task you believe should never have been yours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No need to put me in charge. I took your bins out once during your holiday. I didn't volunteer for life. Tonight's yours.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The neighbours already send you the reminders.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm merely helping this reach the right outcome. I'll introduce you in the group as their permanent bin contact.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Stay in it until I know what I'm doing?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll stay until you send 'I'll handle Thursday.' They can welcome you while I leave.

mechanism: A minimizes itself as former holiday helper while deciding contact succession and exact exit conditions so B takes back bin responsibility.
confusable: Not abandoning its own commitment: A states the original favor was temporary and makes B ownership explicit before withdrawal.
